prose: Devin's Security Swarm docs describe how to set up an automated security scan: create a scan profile, run it interactively and review findings. The sample guidance assumes an internet attacker or a single-tenant user and focuses on public HTTP handlers, OAuth callbacks, API tokens, admin actions and tenant data.

The investigation rules tell Devin to trace untrusted input through middleware to the sensitive operation, cite exact files and lines, account for existing mitigations and not report theoretical issues a mitigation blocks. Triage guidance covers deduplicating and prioritizing findings.
highlights: Focus: auth bypass, cross-tenant access, token leaks, injection, SSRF
Trace input from route to sensitive operation
